description: This script automates the generation and post-processing of markdown documentation files (.md) from JSON plugin data, including invoking a json_generator and cleaning up links across generated documentation.

methods.name: convert_json_to_md
methods.description: Generates markdown files from JSON plugin files by invoking an external JSON generator script.

methods.name: postprocess_md
methods.description: Modifies generated markdown files to fix link issues by string replacements.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Coordinates the overall process: generating markdown files, post-processing, and cleanup.
